title: Workflow
body:
***Logging in***
Fisrt connect to OpenVPN.
Then connect to INS on the school computers
Or from the Linux console,

Navigate using [[Shell]]
```sh
$ ssh <user>@<school-host>
```

***Workspace*** 
The default [[Directory]] is `users/<user>` 

Navigate to library, copy any needed files
```sh
cd users/library
```

***Creating a new CPP file*** 
```sh
emacs my_file.cpp
```
This will write a new cpp file and open it in [[EMACS]]
**Do this in the <user> [[Directory]]**
